title: Deep Bayesian Approaches for Interpretable Nonlinear Structural System Identification
abstract: arXiv:2610.36633v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: System identification, namely the inference of mathematical representations of dynamical systems from measured data, is fundamental to engineering diagnostics, prognostics, and decision-making. Bayesian filtering offers a principled framework for probabilistic state estimation but traditionally relies on prescribed transition and observation models. Recent advances in deep Bayesian filtering address this limitation by embedding learnable representations within probabilistic state-space formulations, enabling data-driven identification of unknown dynamics while retaining physical structure and uncertainty-aware inference.   This tutorial provides a systematic introduction to deep Bayesian filtering for nonlinear structural system identification, focusing on the interplay between learned dynamics, physical inductive biases, and posterior inference. translated_title: 面向可解释非线性结构系统辨识的深度贝叶斯方法
translated_abstract: 系统辨识，即从测量数据中推断动态系统数学表示的过程，是工程诊断、预测和决策制定的基础。贝叶斯滤波为概率状态估计提供了一个有原则的框架，但传统上依赖于预先设定的转移和观测模型。深度贝叶斯滤波的最新进展通过在概率状态空间公式中嵌入可学习的表示来解决这一局限，在保留物理结构和不确定性感知推断的同时，实现了对未知动力学的数据驱动辨识。本教程系统性地介绍了用于非线性结构系统辨识的深度贝叶斯滤波方法，重点探讨学习到的动力学、物理归纳偏置与后验推断之间的相互作用。深度马尔可夫模型（Deep Markov Model）作为数据驱动的参考模型，而物理引导的深度马尔可夫模型……
tldr: 本教程系统介绍了将可学习表示嵌入概率状态空间框架的深度贝叶斯滤波方法，通过结合物理归纳偏置与后验推断，实现了非线性结构系统辨识中兼具物理可解释性与不确定性感知的数据驱动动力学建模。
en_tdlr: This tutorial systematically introduces deep Bayesian filtering that embeds learnable representations within probabilistic state-space frameworks, combining physical inductive biases with posterior inference to achieve interpretable, uncertainty-aware, data-driven identification of nonlinear structural dynamics.
